notes: Modern typeset (computer-font) pecha in a ruled frame; vertical Tibetan margin label on left; Latin '330 (B)' rotated in right margin; tsheg-gter shad (༔) punctuation throughout; first line begins mid-word continuation from previous leaf.

Dense handwritten dbu med (tshugs-style) pecha in frame; page number '214' rotated in left margin; mantra syllables with × separators in line 1-2 and 6; small cramped writing, syllables not confidently readable.

Highly stylised/unusual headless script (possibly 'khyug yig or a Bon ornamental script; not standard uchen), not legible to me as standard Tibetan; first line has an opening mark then a large gap; handwritten vertical marginal label left; handwritten Arabic numeral '73' at right edge of line 4; no right frame. Line count reliable, script identity uncertain.
Modern typeset pecha in ruled frame; first line starts with ཧཱུྃ༔ followed by a wide gap; Tibetan glyph label in left margin; Latin '31 (A)' rotated in right margin.

Handwritten/manuscript-style pecha; lines 1-3 in larger script, lines 4-6 in noticeably smaller dense script (possibly commentary); heavy black vertical bars at both inner frame edges; vertical Tibetan margin label on left; printed '541' outside left frame; show-through/smudging noise especially on lines 5-6 and below frame.

Woodblock-style uchen pecha with many mantra syllables (ༀ, ཧཱུྃ, ཨཱཿ-type stacks); line 1 begins with ༄༅། and a gap; vertical Tibetan marginal label left and a dark smeared vertical strip inside left frame; black bar at right frame edge; printed '185' outside left frame.

Woodblock print, somewhat faint/broken impression; line 1 starts with ༄༅། then gap and a title-like phrase; vertical Tibetan marginal label left; faint handwritten pencil '213' at top-left outside frame.
Dense handwritten dbu med (tshugs) pecha in frame; × separators appear in lines 4-6; page number '174' rotated in left margin; no other marginal label visible.

Western-format book page, single column, loosely spaced typed/printed uchen with wide tsheg spacing; page number '(73)' centred at foot; speckle noise and dashed marks in left margin; dark bar at bottom edge.

Same unusual stylised headless script as 6a37c25563d3f620b49f7e2e (possibly 'khyug yig or Bon ornamental script), not legible to me as standard Tibetan; lines 3-4 contain long stretches of much smaller interlinear-style cursive annotation within the line; line 1 has opening mark then large gap; handwritten vertical marginal label and '511' rotated in left margin.

Modern typeset book page; 10 verse lines each starting མ་ followed by 4 prose/colophon lines (contains Tibetan numerals mid-line). Lower half blank. Page number '147' (Arabic) at bottom. Left edge shows cut-off syllable fragments of the facing page (~13 fragments), not counted.

Handwritten dbu-med leaf with only two sparse lines, large gaps between word groups; a short syllable hangs below the right end of line 2. Rotated Arabic page number '244' at right. Odd marks/strokes in left margin (possibly a third-line start or margin label). Most of the leaf is blank; possibly end of a text.

Framed xylograph pecha leaf, dense dbu-can; many small interlinear annotations (mchan) and tiny-script insertions within and between lines, not counted as body lines. Left margin has a vertical Tibetan label panel and rotated Arabic page number '447'. Bold/heavy print, some smudging.

Errata table (title + 4-column header: page, wrong, corrected, line). 17 table rows occupying 19 physical lines (row '49' wraps to 3 lines). Row page numbers in Arabic numerals, line numbers in Tibetan numerals. Title and header counted as other_lines plus page number '(1)' at bottom. Heavy show-through/bleed from the reverse side; smudges at top.

Handwritten dbu-med (cursive) leaf between double vertical rules; 8 full lines, last ends with a dotted trailing mark. Small interlinear insertion above line 4 (not counted). Rotated Arabic page number '226' at left.

Modern typeset verse page between double rules: 1 line, heading '༄ འབྲོག་པ།', 4 verse lines, heading '༄ འབྲོག་ཕྲུག', 4 verse lines, gap, 4 verse lines. 2 section headings counted in other_lines with page number '- 78 -'.

Handwritten dbu-med leaf between double vertical rules; first line begins with an opening mark followed by a wide gap (start of a text). Left margin: rotated Arabic page number '615' and a vertical Tibetan margin label.

Two-column list of short entries (women's names, many beginning ཇོ་མོ་), 25 lines per column = 50 lines total; not running prose. last_line_end is the bottom of the right column. Footer: journal title, Tibetan numerals (year/issue) and Arabic page number '43'.

Handwritten dbu-med leaf, no frame; phrases separated by terma marks (༔). Left margin vertical Tibetan label (two parts); rotated Arabic page number '246' at right. Lines slightly wavy; speckle noise.

Leaf with a single line of dbu-med text at top (opening mark, wide gap, then three phrase groups); rest of leaf blank. Left margin: Arabic page number '579' and vertical Tibetan label; small mark at bottom right corner (not counted). Likely final leaf of a text.

Handwritten/woodblock uchen leaf, high-contrast binarized scan with speckle noise; arabic page number 259 in left margin; no frame except left and right vertical rules; first line starts with ༄༅། then a gap.

Dense commentary leaf; mixed large and very small (interlinear/annotation-size) uchen throughout, first line entirely in small script; many small-script glosses inline in other lines; arabic page number 750 printed rotated in left margin; syllables too small to read confidently.
Blank framed pecha leaf; only the arabic page number 486 printed rotated in the right margin panel.

Modern hand-calligraphed portrait book page in a double-ruled frame; verse in three stanza blocks (5 + 5 + 2 lines), stanzas 2 and 3 start with an indented right-aligned line (counted as body). Other lines: centered heading inside frame (སྔོན་ཚིག།, a title, counted as other), Tibetan page number ༥༩༡ above frame, small marginal mark left of frame, -591- below frame.

Title page (1a) of a woodblock pecha: a single title line inside a nested decorative frame, rest of leaf empty; faint print; vertical Tibetan marginal label at left edge of the frame; Latin '1a' folio label at upper right.

Modern typeset pecha-format page; text ends after two lines (end of text/colophon), remainder of frame blank. Left margin panel has three stacked Tibetan labels; arabic 951 rotated in right margin panel.

Hand-written/drawn modern pecha-format page; three lines, last line short and ends at a step in the frame (end of text), lower part of frame empty. Tibetan marginal label in left panel; arabic 516 rotated in right panel.

Typeset pecha-format page, almost blank: one short line at top-left consisting of an initial syllable with visarga-like marks (ཐིཿ-like, uncertain), then དགེའོ།། and a final ||. Vertical Tibetan label in left margin panel; arabic 14 rotated in right panel.

Typeset pecha-format page, almost blank: one short line at top-left of a few syllables separated by terma marks (༔), ending with three ornamental/mantra-like stacked syllables; rest of frame empty. Vertical Tibetan label in left panel; arabic 132 rotated in right panel.

Woodblock pecha leaf, verso (Latin label '78b' at upper right); six lines in a single-ruled frame, some ink faint/broken; a handwritten mark at the top-left corner of the leaf (not text). Damaged/dark leaf edges.
